name: luaux-lsp
description: Editor support for .luaux — highlighting, completion and diagnostics for LuauX, JSX-style markup for Luau

luaux.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to `luaux-lsp`. Empty searches `PATH`, then rokit's tool storage, then the copy bundled with this extension.

luaux.luauLsp.path.markdownDescription: Path to `luau-lsp`, which answers the Luau half. Empty searches the same places. If it is not found, LuauX still works and simply answers nothing that needed Luau types.

luaux.autoClosingTags.markdownDescription: Close a tag as you finish opening it: typing `<Frame>` puts `</Frame>` after the cursor.

luaux.completion.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer completions. Turn it off to leave them to another language server; every other feature keeps working.

luaux.hover.enabled.markdownDescription: Answer hovers. Turn it off to leave them to another language server; every other feature keeps working.

luaux.plugin.enabled.markdownDescription: Listen for the [luau-lsp Roblox Studio plugin](https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/10913122509), which sends the DataModel so `game.ReplicatedStorage.Thing` has a type without a rojo sourcemap. Nothing happens until the plugin is installed and sending.

luaux.plugin.port.markdownDescription: Port to listen on for the Studio plugin. The same default the plugin posts to. Only one process can hold it: if the luau-lsp extension has `#luau-lsp.plugin.enabled#` on, move one of the two and use `#luaux.plugin.forwardTo#`.

luaux.plugin.forwardTo.markdownDescription: Re-post every DataModel to a second plugin server on this port, so the luau-lsp extension keeps receiving it too. The Studio plugin can only be pointed at one port, so whichever extension holds it forwards to the other.

luaux.plugin.maximumRequestBodySize.markdownDescription: Largest DataModel to accept from the Studio plugin. A large place file can exceed this, and the plugin is told when it does.

luaux.trace.server.description: Log traffic between the editor and the LuauX server.

luau-lsp.types.definitionFiles.markdownDescription: A mapping of package names to paths of extra type definition files, forwarded to the `luau-lsp` this extension runs for `.luaux` files. Declared here so it works without the `luau-lsp` extension installed; Roblox's own definitions still come first, with these layered on top. A bare array of paths (the setting's old shape) is still accepted.

luau-lsp.types.documentationFiles.markdownDescription: Extra documentation files for hover, forwarded to the `luau-lsp` this extension runs for `.luaux` files.

luau-lsp.types.roblox.markdownDescription: Load Roblox API types (`game`, `workspace`, and so on) into the `luau-lsp` this extension runs. Turn off for a non-Roblox project.

luau-lsp.types.robloxSecurityLevel.markdownDescription: Which Roblox API security level's globals to load. Falls back to whichever level `#luau-lsp.types.definitionFiles#`'s downloader has on disk if this exact one is missing.

luau-lsp.platform.type.markdownDescription: Set to `standard` for a non-Roblox project, so `game` and `workspace` are not assumed to exist.

luau-lsp.platform.baseLuaurc.markdownDescription: Path to a `.luaurc` whose settings apply as a base to every file, forwarded to the `luau-lsp` this extension runs.

luau-lsp.fflags.enableByDefault.markdownDescription: Whether Luau feature flags default to on in the `luau-lsp` this extension runs. Off means only flags explicitly named in `#luau-lsp.fflags.override#` are enabled.

luau-lsp.fflags.enableNewSolver.markdownDescription: Enable Luau's new type solver. Needed for types written with `keyof<>` or user-defined type functions — without it those resolve to an error type.

luau-lsp.fflags.override.markdownDescription: Explicit Luau feature flag values (e.g. `{ "LuauSolverV2": "true" }`), forwarded to the `luau-lsp` this extension runs. Wins over `#luau-lsp.fflags.sync#`'s fetched values.

luau-lsp.fflags.sync.markdownDescription: Fetch Roblox's current Luau flag values and pass them to the `luau-lsp` this extension runs, so `.luaux` gets the same answers as the `.luau` it compiles to.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node test/spec.mjs && node test/plugin.mjs
